blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Recognizing hand-drawn geometric shapes is a foundational sub-problem of sketch recognition, with applications in education, human-computer interaction, and diagram digitization. This paper presents the design, implementation, and evaluation of a desktop application that recognizes four basic hand-drawn geometric shapes, circle, square, rectangle, and triangle using a compact Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). A dataset of 2,000 labeled 28 × \times 28-pixel shape images was collected independently and released publicly. The classifier consists of three convolutional blocks (16, 32, and 64 filters) with max-pooling, an in-model data-augmentation stage (random horizontal flip, rotation, and zoom), a dropout-regularized dense layer of 128 units, and a 4-way linear output layer, totaling 97,956 trainable parameters. The network is trained with the Adam optimizer on a sparse categorical cross-entropy objective computed directly on logits. On an 80/20 train-validation split, the model achieves 94.80% training accuracy and 96.01% validation accuracy with a validation loss of 0.1437. A Tkinter-based graphical interface allows a user to draw a shape with the mouse and receive an immediate class prediction with a confidence score. We situate this system within the broader sketch- and shape-recognition literature, compare its accuracy against related hand-drawn shape classification studies, and discuss the limitations inherent to a small, single-contributor dataset. The complete source code, trained model, and per-class datasets are released publicly to support reproducibility.
blocks.zh: 识别手绘几何形状是草图识别的基础子问题,在教育、人机互动和图表数字化方面都有应用。 本文介绍一个桌面应用程序的设计,实施和评价情况,该应用程序使用紧凑的Convolutional Neural Network(CNN)识别出四个基本的手绘几何形状,圆形,正方形,矩形和三角形. 由2000个被标注为28×\times 28-像素形状图像的数据集被独立收集并公开发布. 分级器由三个带最大集合(16个,32个和64个滤波器)的分级块,一个模型中的数据增强阶段(随机水平翻转,旋转,和缩放),128个单元的淘汰-正态密集层,以及4向线性输出层,共97,956个可列车参数. 该网络与亚当优化器一起培训 直接在登录器上计算出一个稀有的 绝对的交叉目标 在80/20次列车验证分出时,该型号实现了94.80%的训练精度和96.01%的验证精度,验证损失为0.1437. 基于Tkinter的图形界面允许用户用鼠标绘制出形状并获得具有信心分数的即时类预测. 我们把这一系统放在更广泛的草图和形状识别文献中,将其准确性与相关的手绘形状分类研究进行比较,并讨论一个小型的单一贡献者数据集固有的局限性。 完整的源代码,训练有素的模型,以及每类数据集都公开发布,以支持可再生性.

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Sketching is one of the most natural ways for humans to externalize visual and spatial ideas, and geometric primitives. Geometric shapes such as circles, squares, rectangles, and triangles are the building blocks from which more complex hand-drawn diagrams, charts, and figures are composed. Automatically recognizing these primitives from freehand input has practical value for educational software that gives students instant feedback on geometry exercises, for note-digitization pipelines that convert whiteboard sketches into structured diagrams, and for sketch-based user interfaces more broadly.
blocks.zh: 勾搭是人类将视觉和空间思想外化的最自然的方法之一,也是几何原始. 圆形,正方形,矩形等几何形状和三角形是更复杂的手绘图,图表和数字所构成的构件. 从自由手输入中自动识别出这些原始物,对于让学生立即反馈几何练习的教育软件,对于将白板草图转换成结构图的注释数字化管道,以及更广义的草图用户界面,都具有实用价值.

blocks.en: While humans distinguish a circle from a triangle almost instantly and with near-perfect accuracy, teaching a machine to do the same from raw pixel input is non-trivial: strokes vary in thickness, closure, symmetry, and scale, and classical geometric descriptors are brittle to these variations. Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) address this by learning spatial-hierarchical features directly from pixel data, removing the need for hand-engineered shape descriptors, and have become the default approach for small-image classification problems of this kind.
blocks.zh: 虽然人类几乎立即将一圈从三角形中分出,且精度接近完美,但教一机器如何从原始像素输入中分出相同的一圈是非三相的:中风在厚度,闭合,对称,和尺度上都有所不同,而古典几何描述法对这些变异是模糊的. Cinvolutional Neural Networks(CNNs)通过直接从像素数据中学习空间-分级特征来解决这个问题,消除了手动外形描述符的需求,并成为了这种小图像分类问题的默认方法.

blocks.en: This paper documents a complete, self-contained pipeline for hand-drawn geometric shape recognition: a custom-collected dataset, a compact CNN trained on that dataset, and a working Tkinter desktop application that captures freehand mouse input and returns a real-time shape prediction with a confidence score. The specific contributions of this paper are:
blocks.zh: 本文记录了用于手绘几何形状识别的完整自成一体的管道:一个自定义收集的数据集,一个精密的CNN训练于该数据集的软件,以及一个工作中的Tkinter桌面应用程序,该应用程序可以捕捉自由手鼠标输入并返回一个具有置信分数的实时形状预测. 本文件的具体贡献是:

blocks.en: • A custom dataset of 2,000 labeled, hand-drawn 28 × \times 28 images spanning four geometric classes (circle, square, rectangle, triangle), released publicly on Kaggle for reuse by other researchers. • A lightweight CNN architecture, three convolutional blocks with 16, 32, and 64 filters, an in-model data-augmentation stage, and 97,956 trainable parameters in total that reaches 96.01% validation accuracy despite the small dataset size. • A working, open-source graphical desktop application (Tkinter) that demonstrates end-to-end, real-time inference from freehand mouse input, including the exact preprocessing chain (grayscale conversion, resizing, edge enhancement) used at inference time.
blocks.zh: 二. 支助 由2000个有标签的自定义数据集,手绘28×\times 28个图像,跨越了四个几何类(圆形,正方形,矩形,三角形),在Kaggle上公开发布,供其他研究人员再用. 二. 支助 轻量级CNN架构,有16个,32个和64个滤波器的3个回旋区块,是模拟数据增强阶段,以及97,956个可训练参数,尽管数据集尺寸小,但总参数达到96.01%的验证精度. ^ 一个工作,开源的图形桌面应用程序(Tkinter),可以显示从自由手鼠标输入的端到端的实时推论,包括推论时所使用的精确的预处理链(grayscale转换,再大小,边缘增强).

blocks.en: A custom dataset of 2,000 labeled, hand-drawn 28 × \times 28 images spanning four geometric classes (circle, square, rectangle, triangle), released publicly on Kaggle for reuse by other researchers.
blocks.zh: 由2000个有标签的自定义数据集,手绘28×\times 28个图像,跨越了四个几何类(圆形,正方形,矩形,三角形),在Kaggle上公开发布,供其他研究人员再用.

blocks.en: A lightweight CNN architecture, three convolutional blocks with 16, 32, and 64 filters, an in-model data-augmentation stage, and 97,956 trainable parameters in total that reaches 96.01% validation accuracy despite the small dataset size.
blocks.zh: 一个轻量级的CNN架构,三个有16个,32个和64个滤波器的回旋区块,一个模拟数据加固阶段,以及97,956个可列车参数,尽管数据集尺寸小,但总参数仍能达到96.01%的验证精度.

blocks.en: A working, open-source graphical desktop application (Tkinter) that demonstrates end-to-end, real-time inference from freehand mouse input, including the exact preprocessing chain (grayscale conversion, resizing, edge enhancement) used at inference time.
blocks.zh: 一个工作,开源的图形桌面应用程序(Tkinter),可以显示从自由手鼠标输入的端到端的实时推论,包括推论时所使用的精确的预处理链(grayscale转换,再大小,边缘增强).

blocks.en: The remainder of this paper is organized as follows. Section II reviews related work in classical shape recognition, sketch-recognition benchmarks, and CNN-based approaches to hand-drawn shape classification. Section III describes the dataset. Section IV details the proposed system, including the exact network architecture recovered from the released model checkpoint. Section V reports experimental results. Section VI compares these results against related studies. Section VII discusses the findings, Section VIII enumerates the limitations and threats to validity, and Section IX concludes with directions for future work.
blocks.zh: 本文件的其余部分编排如下。 第二节审查有关古典形状识别、草图识别基准和有线电视新闻网手工绘制形状分类方法等工作。 第三节介绍数据集。 第四节详细介绍了拟议的系统,包括从已放行的示范检查站收回的确切网络架构。 第五节报告实验结果。 第六节将这些结果同相关研究进行比较。 第七节讨论了调查结果,第八节列举了对有效性的限制和威胁,第九节最后提出了今后工作的方向。

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: II-A Classical and Geometric Approaches
blocks.zh: II-A 古典和几何方法

blocks.en: Prior to the widespread adoption of learned representations, shape recognition relied on geometric and contour-based descriptors. The Hough transform [ 6 ] detects parametric primitives such as lines and circles by accumulating votes in a parameter space, and remains a standard tool for detecting well-formed geometric primitives in clean line drawings. Contour-based techniques approximate a shape’s outline with polygons or moment invariants and classify based on descriptors such as corner count, aspect ratio, or circularity. These methods can be effective on clean, noise-free input, but are sensitive to stroke gaps, self-intersections, and the irregularities typical of freehand sketching, which motivates learning-based alternatives.
blocks.zh: 在广泛采用所学的表示法之前,形状识别依赖于几何和轮廓描述法. Hough变型 [6]通过在参数空间中积累选票来检测线和圈等参数原始物,并仍然是在清洁行图中检测成形几何原始物的标准工具. 以相轮为基础的技术将形状的轮廓与多边形或瞬间变异性相近,并根据角计数、外观比或圆相等描述法进行分类。 这些方法在清洁而无噪声的输入上可以有效,但对于中风间隙,自相交织,以及平手素描所典型的不合规定之处十分敏感,这激发了以学习为基础的替代方法.

blocks.en: II-B Sketch-Recognition Datasets and Benchmarks
blocks.zh: II-B 速记识别数据集和基准

blocks.en: Eitz et al. [ 7 ] conducted the first large-scale study of human sketching behavior, collecting 20,000 sketches spanning 250 object categories (the TU-Berlin sketch dataset) and showing that even humans correctly classify unseen sketches only 73% of the time, while a bag-of-features representation with a multi-class SVM reached 56% accuracy. This result illustrates that general object-level sketch recognition is intrinsically difficult due to high intra-class variability. At a larger scale, Ha and Eck [ 8 ] introduced the QuickDraw-derived sketch-rnn framework, trained on millions of vector sketches collected through the Quick, Draw! game, and modeled sketches as sequences of pen strokes rather than static raster images, enabling both recognition and generative sketch modeling. These works establish that sketch recognition spans a spectrum from small, well-defined primitive sets (as addressed in this paper) to broad, open-vocabulary object recognition, with corresponding differences in achievable accuracy.
blocks.zh: 艾兹等. [7] 对人类草图行为进行了第一次大规模研究,收集了2万幅草图,涵盖250个对象类别(TU-柏林草图数据集),并显示即使是人类也仅将未见草图正确分类了73%的时间,而多级SVM的袋状地层代表则达到了56%的精度. 这一结果表明,由于类内差异很大,一般对象级草图识别在本质上很困难. 在更大的尺度上,Ha和Eck[8]引入了QuickDraw-衍生出草图-rnn框架,训练了通过快取, Draw所收集的上百万个矢量草图! 游戏中,并建模了草图,作为笔划而不是静态光栅图像的序列,使识别和基因素描模型化成为可能. 这些作品确定草图识别范围从小的,定义明确的原始相片(如本文所述)到广的,开放式的物体识别,在可实现的准确性上有相应的差异.

blocks.en: II-C CNN-Based Recognition of Hand-Drawn Shapes
blocks.zh: II-C 有线电视新闻网对手画形状的识别

blocks.en: The use of small CNNs on low-resolution, grayscale-like images was established by LeCun et al. [ 9 ] , whose LeNet architecture on 28 × \times 28/32 × \times 32 digit images directly motivates the input resolution used in this work and in many subsequent small-image classification systems. Larger-scale CNNs such as AlexNet [ 10 ] later demonstrated that depth and parameter count can be scaled substantially for richer natural-image tasks, though such capacity is unnecessary for a four-class geometric primitive problem of the kind addressed here.
blocks.zh: 使用小型有线电视新闻网在低分辨率,灰度相像的图像上由LeCun等[9]建立,其LeNet架构在28 ×\times 28/32 ×\times 32位数图像上直接激发了本作和后来许多小相像分类系统中使用的输入分辨率. 更大规模的有线电视新闻网,如AlexNet[10],后来证明,深度和参数计数可以大幅扩大,以完成更丰富的自然成像任务,尽管这种能力对于本文述及的四等几何原始问题来说是不必要的.

blocks.en: Most directly related to the present work, Alam et al. [ 11 ] proposed CnN-RFc, a hybrid CNN and random-forest classifier for hand-drawn mathematical geometric shapes, evaluated on a benchmark of 20,000 images across eight classes (circle, kite, parallelogram, square, rectangle, rhombus, trapezoid, triangle), reporting 98% accuracy with a Light Gradient Boosting Machine variant. Their work confirms that CNN-based feature extraction is well suited to hand-drawn geometric-shape classification and provides a useful accuracy reference point, albeit on a larger and more class-diverse benchmark than the one used here (Section VI ).
blocks.zh: 与目前工作最直接相关的是Alam等人。 [11] 建议的CnN-RFc,一个混合有线电视新闻网和用于手绘数学几何形状的随机-森林分级器,以两万个图像为基准进行评价,分为8个类别(圆形,风筝形,平行图形,正方形,矩形,rhombus,tapezoid,三角形),报告精度为98%,有轻梯形助推器变型. 他们的工作证实,基于CNN的地物提取非常适合手取几何形状的分类,并提供了一个有用的准确性参考点,尽管比这里所用的基准要大,更能分级(第六节)。

blocks.en: Regularization techniques adopted in this work are similarly well established: dropout [ 12 ] randomly deactivates units during training to reduce co-adaptation and overfitting, and data augmentation surveyed broadly by Shorten and Khoshgoftaar [ 13 ] synthesizes label-preserving input variations (flips, rotations, zooms) to improve generalization when training data is limited, which is directly relevant given the modest size of the dataset used in this study.
blocks.zh: 这项工作中采用的规范化技术同样也得到了公认的:辍学[12]在培训期间随机停用减少协同适应和过度适应的单元,以及由Shorten和Khoshgoftaar广泛调查的数据增强[13]综合了保留标签的输入变量(平面、旋转、缩放),以便在培训数据有限时改进通缩性,鉴于本研究使用的数据集规模不大,这直接相关。

blocks.en: In summary, this work differs from the broader sketch-recognition literature in scope: rather than targeting large, open-vocabulary sketch categories (as in [ 7 , 8 ] ), it focuses on a minimal, well-defined set of four geometric primitives, using a deliberately lightweight CNN (under 100,000 parameters) suited to real-time CPU inference within a desktop GUI, rather than a server or GPU-class model.
blocks.zh: 简言之,本作与范围较广的草图识别文献不同: 与其针对大型的,开放式的草图类(如[7,8]),而侧重于一套最小的,定义清楚的四种几何原始,使用一种特意轻量级的CNN(低于10万个参数),适合桌面图形界面内实时CPU推断,而不是服务器或GPU类模型.

blocks.en: III Dataset
blocks.zh: 三. 数据集

blocks.en: III-A Data Collection
blocks.zh: 三-A 数据收集

blocks.en: No public dataset of hand-drawn geometric shapes suited to this task was readily available at the time of the original project, so a dataset of 2,000 images spanning four classes, circle, square, rectangle, and triangle was created from scratch. Shapes were hand-drawn and compressed to a uniform resolution of 28 × \times 28 pixels, matching the input resolution conventions established by classic small-image benchmarks such as MNIST [ 9 ] . The per-class distribution of the 2,000 images is not recorded in the original project documentation and is therefore not reported here; we note this as a documentation gap rather than assert a class balance that cannot be verified.
blocks.zh: 在最初的项目进行时,还没有适合这项工作的手绘几何形状的公共数据集,因此从零开始就创建了由2000个图像组成的数据集,这些图像跨越了四类,圆形,正方形,矩形和三角形. 形状被手取并被压缩为28 ×\times 28像素的统一分辨率,与像 MNIST [9]等经典小图像基准所设定的输入分辨率常规相匹配. 最初的项目文件中没有记录这2 000幅图像的分级分布,因此这里没有报告;我们注意到这是一个文件空白,而不是坚持无法核实的分级平衡。

blocks.en: III-B Preprocessing and Splitting
blocks.zh: 三-B 预处理和拆分

blocks.en: The complete set of 2,000 images was split 80/20 into training and validation partitions using Keras’ image-preprocessing utilities. Pixel values are rescaled from the [ 0,255 ] [0,255] range to [ 0 , 1 ] [0,1] by a Rescaling layer (scale factor 1 / 255 1/255 ) situated at the input of the network itself, and three data-augmentation layers RandomFlip (horizontal), RandomRotation (factor ± 0.1 \pm 0.1 ), and RandomZoom (height factor 0.1 0.1 ) are likewise embedded directly in the model graph and are active only during training, so that a single saved checkpoint contains the complete, reproducible preprocessing pipeline.
blocks.zh: 利用Keras的图像预处理设施,将完整的2 000个图像分成80/20,作为培训和验证分区。 像素值从[0,255][0,255]到[0,1] [0,1]的幅度由位于网络本身输入的调高层(尺度因子 1/2551/255)和三个数据调高层随机放出(横向),随机旋转(因子±0.1\pm 0.1),随机Zoom(高度因子0.1)同样被直接嵌入到模型图中,仅在训练期间才有效,这样一个被节省的检查站就包含完整,可复制的预处理管道.

blocks.en: III-C Dataset Availability
blocks.zh: 三-C 数据集可用性

blocks.en: The four class-wise datasets were published on Kaggle [ 2 , 3 , 4 , 5 ] to support reuse by other researchers working on hand-drawn shape or sketch-recognition tasks.
blocks.zh: 四个分级数据集被发表在"Kaggle"[2,3,4,5]上,以支持其他从事手绘形状或草图识别任务的研究人员的再利用.

blocks.en: Fig. 1: End-to-end system pipeline: canvas input capture, preprocessing, CNN inference, and prediction output.
blocks.zh: 图1:从端到端的系统管道:画布输入捕捉,预处理,CNN推断,和预测输出.

blocks.en: IV Proposed System
blocks.zh: 四 拟议系统

blocks.en: IV-A System Overview
blocks.zh: IV-A 系统概览

blocks.en: The system consists of three stages, illustrated in Fig. 1 : (1) freehand shape capture through a drawing canvas, (2) a fixed preprocessing chain that converts the captured drawing into a normalized 28 × \times 28 input tensor, and (3) classification by a trained CNN that outputs one of four class labels together with a softmax confidence score.
blocks.zh: 系统由三个阶段组成,用图1来说明:(1)通过绘画布进行自由手形捕捉,(2)固定的预处理链将所取取取的取取取的取取取转化为正版的28×\times 28个输入计分器,(3)由训练有素的有线电视新闻网进行分类,输出出四个类标签中的一个并配有软马克斯置信分.

blocks.en: IV-B Drawing Interface and Input Capture
blocks.zh: IV-B 绘图接口和输入抓取

blocks.en: The front end is a desktop application built with Python’s Tkinter toolkit. It provides a 500 × \times 500-pixel white canvas on which the user draws freehand with the mouse using a black pen of adjustable width (5 px by default); the in-memory PIL image mirrors every stroke drawn on the visible canvas. When the user requests a prediction, this 500 × \times 500 image is converted to a single-channel-plus-alpha (‘LA’) representation, resized to 28 × \times 28 pixels, and sharpened with PIL’s EDGE_ENHANCE_MORE filter before being written to disk and reloaded through Keras’ image-loading utility, which returns it as a 3-channel (RGB) array to match the network’s expected ( 28 , 28 , 3 ) (28,28,3) input shape.
blocks.zh: 前端是用Python的Tkinter工具包所建的桌面应用程序. 它提供了一个500×\times 500-像素白色画布,用户使用可调整宽度(默认为5px)的黑笔与鼠标一起抽取自由手;内膜PIL图像镜照了可见画布上所抽取的每一下中风. 当用户请求预测时,这500x\times500图像被转换为单通道+-alpha("LA")代表,被调整为28x\times 28像素,并用PIL的EDGE_ENHANCE来磨合. 更多的过滤器在被写入磁盘之前,然后通过 Keras 的图像加载工具重新加载, 它返回为3个通道( RGB) 阵列, 以匹配网络的预期( 28, 28, 3) ( 28, 28, 3) 输入形状 。

blocks.en: IV-C CNN Architecture
blocks.zh: 四-C CNN 结构

blocks.en: The exact architecture below was recovered directly from the released Keras checkpoint ( shapedetector_model_4b.h5 ) rather than reconstructed from memory, and is reported here layer-by-layer for reproducibility. The classifier is a compact CNN consisting of three convolutional blocks (16, 32, and 64 filters respectively, each with 3 × \times 3 kernels, same padding, and ReLU activation), each followed by 2 × \times 2 max-pooling. The final pooled feature map ( 3 × 3 × 64 3\times 3\times 64 ) passes through a dropout layer (rate 0.2), is flattened to a 576-dimensional vector, and fed into a fully connected layer of 128 ReLU units before a final 4-unit linear (logit) output layer. Table I lists every layer, its output shape, and its parameter count.
blocks.zh: 以下确切的建筑直接取自已释放的Keras检查站(造型师_model_4b.h5),而不是从内存中重建而来,在此逐层上报,以供再出. 分级器是一个紧凑的有线电视新闻网,由三个转录区块(分别为16个,32个和64个滤波器)组成,每个滤波器有3××分3个内核,同分活化,再活化再活化再活化再活化出2×分活化再活化出2×分活化再活化. 最终集合特征图(3×3×64 3\times 3\times 64)会经过一个退出层(速率为0.2),被平分为576维向量,在最终4个单元线性(logit)输出层之前被输入到一个完全连接的128个ReLU单元. 页:1 我列出每一层,它的输出形状, 和它的参数数。

blocks.zh: 表格 一:网络架构和参数计数(共计:97,956可列车参数). * 仅在培训期间任职。

blocks.en: The network is trained with the Adam optimizer (learning rate = 0.001 =0.001 , β 1 = 0.9 \beta_{1}=0.9 , β 2 = 0.999 \beta_{2}=0.999 , ε = 1 × 10 − 7 \varepsilon=1\times 10^{-7} ), minimizing sparse categorical cross-entropy computed directly on the logits ( from_logits=True ) for numerical stability, with classification accuracy tracked as the reported metric. These values are taken directly from the training configuration embedded in the released checkpoint. The exact number of training epochs, batch size, and total training time were not recorded in the original project artifacts and are therefore not reported; a fully reproducible re-run would require retraining with the released dataset and code under an explicitly logged configuration.

blocks.en: With only 97,956 trainable parameters, the network is several orders of magnitude smaller than large-scale image classifiers such as AlexNet [ 10 ] (approximately 60 million parameters), making it well suited to real-time CPU-only inference inside a desktop GUI without dedicated graphics hardware consistent with the sub-second prediction latency observed in the accompanying application.
blocks.zh: 网络只有97,956个可训练参数,是比AlexNet [10]等大型图像分级器(约6000万个参数)更小的几个数量级,使其非常适合桌面图形用户界面内部的实时CPU只推论,没有专用图形硬件,与配套应用中观察到的子秒预测延迟一致.

blocks.en: VI Comparison with Related Work
blocks.zh: 六 与相关工作的比较

blocks.en: Table III places the reported accuracy of this work alongside two related studies discussed in Section II . The comparison is illustrative rather than a controlled benchmark: the three studies differ substantially in class count, dataset size, and task difficulty, so accuracy figures are not directly comparable and should be read as context rather than a ranked evaluation.
blocks.zh: 表三将报告的这项工作的准确性与第二节所讨论的两项相关研究放在一起。 比较是说明性的,而不是一个可控制的基准:这三项研究在类数,数据集大小和任务难度上差别很大,因此准确性数字并不直接可比较,应被解读为上下文而非排名评价.

blocks.en: TABLE III: Illustrative comparison with related hand-drawn shape/sketch recognition studies.
blocks.zh: 表格 三:与相邻的手绘外形/斯克奇识别研究的比对.

blocks.en: Two observations follow. First, the accuracy achieved here is broadly consistent with Alam et al. [ 11 ] , supporting the view that hand-drawn geometric-primitive classification is a comparatively tractable sub-problem of the broader sketch-recognition space addressed in [ 7 ] , where general object-category sketches are recognized correctly only 56-73% of the time even by humans and dedicated computer-vision pipelines. Second, this work reaches its accuracy with roughly an order of magnitude less training data and a far smaller network than [ 11 ] , suggesting that for a minimal four-class geometric vocabulary, a lightweight CNN is sufficient without requiring a hybrid ensemble classifier.
blocks.zh: 以下两点意见。 首先,这里所达到的准确性与Alam等人大致一致. [11],支持以下观点,即手绘几何-原生分级是[7]所处理的较宽的草图识别空间的可比较可拉动的子问题,一般对象类草图甚至被人类和专用的计算机视觉管线正确识别的时间只有56-73%. 第二,这项工作达到准确性时,培训数据大致比[11]少了几等分,网络也比[11]要小得多,这表明对于最低限度的四等分几何词汇来说,轻量级CNN就足够了,不需要混合综艺分类器.

blocks.en: VII Discussion
blocks.zh: 页:1 讨论情况

blocks.en: The validation accuracy (96.01%) exceeding the training accuracy (94.80%) is consistent with the regularization effect of the embedded dropout and data-augmentation layers (Section IV -C, D), which make the training-time task deliberately harder than plain inference on the (non-augmented) validation set a common and expected pattern when augmentation is applied only during training.
blocks.zh: 验证精度(96.01%)超过训练精度(94.80%)符合嵌入式退学和数据加固层的规范化效果(第四节-C节,D节),这使得训练时间任务故意比(非加固的)验证的简单推论更难,在只在训练期间才适用加固时就确定了一种共同和预期的模式。

blocks.en: More broadly, the results show that a compact, sub-100,000-parameter CNN can achieve strong classification performance on a constrained, four-class shape-recognition problem even when trained on a modest, self-collected dataset of 2,000 images, without requiring transfer learning or a large pretrained backbone. This supports the use of small, task-specific CNNs for narrowly scoped sketch-recognition problems, in contrast to the larger architectures and datasets typically used for open-vocabulary sketch recognition (Section II -B).
blocks.zh: 更广泛地说,结果显示,一个紧凑的10万分参数的CNN可以在一个受限制的四级形状识别问题上实现强分级性能,即使训练了2000个图像的自取自用数据集,而不需要转移学习或大型的先行骨干. 这支持在狭义范围草图识别问题上使用针对任务的小型有线电视新闻网,与通常用于开放式草图识别的较大架构和数据集形成对比(第二节-B节).

blocks.en: VIII Limitations and Threats to Validity
blocks.zh: 八. 对有效性的限制和威胁

blocks.en: • Single-contributor handwriting: all 2,000 images were hand-drawn by one person, which may limit generalization to users with substantially different drawing styles, stroke widths, or input devices (e.g., touchscreen or stylus input, which was not evaluated). • No independent test set: the original project documentation describes only an 80/20 train/validation split, with no separate held-out test set used solely for final reporting; the validation accuracy reported here may therefore be optimistic relative to unseen, out-of-distribution input. • Undocumented training configuration: epoch count, batch size, and total training time are not recorded in the released artifacts, limiting exact reproducibility of the training run (though the architecture and optimizer settings are fully recovered and reported in Section IV ). • Narrow class scope: the classifier distinguishes only four convex/simple primitives and has not been evaluated on additional polygons, overlapping shapes, incomplete strokes, or a rejection (‘not a shape’) class. • Unreported per-class metrics: only aggregate accuracy and loss are available from the original project artifacts; a per-class confusion matrix was not recorded and is not fabricated here.
blocks.zh: · 单一贡献者笔迹:所有2 000幅图像都是由一人手工绘制的,这可能限制对绘画风格、中风宽度或输入设备(例如触摸屏或平面胶片输入,没有评估)大相径庭的用户的概括。 二. 支助 没有独立的测试集:原始项目文件只描述了80/20次列车/验证分拆,没有单独的停放测试集仅用于最终报告;因此,这里报告的验证精度相对于无形的分出输入可能较为乐观. 二. 支助 无文献记载的训练配置: 时代计数,批量大小,总训练时间没有记录在出品文物中,限制了训练的准确再出(虽然建筑和优化器设置完全恢复,并在第四节中报告). ) 窄类范围:分类器只区分出四个凸起/简单原始人,没有被评价额外的多边形,相重叠的外形,不完全的中风,或者拒绝("不是外形")类. 每类未报告的度量衡:原项目文物仅提供总精度和损耗;每类混淆矩阵没有记录,此处没有编造.

blocks.en: IX Conclusion and Future Work
blocks.zh: 九. 结论和今后的工作

blocks.en: This paper presented the design, exact architecture, and evaluation of a lightweight CNN-based system for recognizing hand-drawn geometric shapes, together with a working Tkinter desktop interface for real-time use. Recovered directly from the released model checkpoint, the network uses 97,956 trainable parameters across three convolutional blocks and a dense classification head, trained with Adam on sparse categorical cross-entropy, and reaches 96.01% validation accuracy on a self-collected, four-class, 2,000-image dataset.
blocks.zh: 本文介绍了一个基于CNN的轻量级系统的设计,准确的架构,以及对该系统的评价,该系统用于识别手绘几何形状,以及一个工作中的Tkinter桌面界面,供实时使用. 直接从所放出的模式检查站回收,网络使用97,956个可被训练的参数,跨越了三个进化区块和一个密集的分类头,与亚当一起接受过关于稀疏的断裂横贯的训练,在自取自用,四等,二千像数据集上达到96.01%的验证精度.

blocks.en: Future work includes: expanding the label set to additional polygons (e.g., pentagons, hexagons, stars) and a negative/rejection class for non-shape scribbles; collecting drawings from multiple contributors, including touchscreen and stylus input, to improve generalization; introducing an explicit, held-out test set distinct from the validation split used for model selection; logging and publishing the full training configuration (epochs, batch size, hardware, wall-clock time) for exact reproducibility; and benchmarking lightweight alternative architectures (e.g., depthwise-separable convolutions) for further reductions in parameter count and inference latency on constrained or embedded devices.
